title: Young Couple Outside Church, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A black and white snapshot taken on June 26, 1948, capturing a smiling young couple posing arm-in-arm on a grassy lawn in front of a wooden church with a bell tower and arched windows. The man is wearing a classic post-WWII double-breasted suit with broad lapels and a necktie, while the woman wears a dark patterned dress. This image reflects post-war American community life, religious architecture, and mid-century fashion.
